subject: art-design

moments.title: Durer's Christ-like self-portrait
moments.body: Durer paints himself frontally in the pose conventionally reserved for Christ, signed and dated in Latin.
moments.takeaway: The artist as creator becomes an explicit theme in early modern self-portraiture.

moments.title: Apocalypse woodcuts
moments.body: Durer publishes his Apocalypse series, exploiting print to distribute large-format images at unprecedented scale.
moments.takeaway: Print transformed both religious image culture and an artist's reach.

moments.title: Treatise on measurement
moments.body: Durer publishes the first geometry book in German for a non-specialist audience, applying mathematics to drawing.
moments.takeaway: Northern Renaissance artists were also teachers of theory.

now.title: Print after Durer
now.body: Engraving and woodcut remain studied techniques. Durer's monogram is among the earliest persistent artist brands.
now.open_questions: What is the print equivalent in the age of AI image generation?

reflection: Print made an artist's image distributable centuries before mass photography.
